label: Table column
description: One column of a data table, showing a field of the table's entity. Columns are child nodes so they can be inserted, reordered, hidden, and removed individually, and each can override its header label and width.
usage: Put the number and title first; keep 4–8 columns per table.
Use width sm for numbers, badges, and dates and lg for titles.
Insert a new column with an anchor (after the column it follows).
constraints: Parent must be collection.data_table; field must be a field of the table's entity, used at most once per table.
Columns for fields the viewer cannot read are dropped on the server together with their values.
rich_text and long_text show a one-line plain-text excerpt and are not sortable; multi_select is not sortable.

label.description: Header override; defaults to the field label.

binding.description: Reads one field from each row of the table's query.

accessibility.keyboard: Enter on a sortable header cycles ascending, descending, and unsorted.
accessibility.notes: Sorted headers expose aria-sort; cells use the field type's read-mode rendering.

responsive: Below 720px only the first three columns are shown in the stacked list.
